description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

properties.name: Fighter
properties.description: Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: Focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: Employs martial techniques passed down through generations.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: Combines the martial mastery common to all fighters with a careful study of magic.
